answer: Sybil resistance comes from a rising bond: each agent locks stake to earn or vote, and the bond grows with the number of identities already registered. A farmer splitting one wallet into N fakes must post N separate, pricier bonds, so the marginal cost of each clone climbs superlinearly while honest agents share one stake. Caught double-voters are slashed and their bond pays the reporter. A public stake registry exposes fake identities as low tide exposes rocks; the attacker must fund an ocean of bonds, while honest agents cultivate a garden of reputation that compounds across epochs.
